corrections.text: The article quotes EurekAlert! as saying the reverse-sprinkler question was "made famous in the 1980s by physicist Richard Feynman's failed experimental attempts to resolve it." The source (also republished by New York University) actually reads: "made famous in the 1980s by physicist Richard Feynman's account of his failed experiments." The underlying fact is accurate, but the quoted wording is a paraphrase rather than a verbatim quote.
